file.content:
OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

## Summary

I implemented the required-fields rule for `POST /api/owners` (reject an owner missing or blank in `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`; respond `400` with an `errors` array of offending field names), following the OfficeFloor function-injection pattern.

**Changes:**

1. **`ValidateOwner`** — now runs as the first step of the create pipeline. It keeps `@Valid` for the schema (pattern/length) checks and adds an explicit missing/blank check (null, empty, or whitespace-only) across the five required fields, collecting their names in spec order and throwing a new `MissingOwnerFieldsException` when any are bad. This catches the whitespace-blank case for `address`/`city`, which have no schema pattern and would otherwise slip through bean validation.

2. **`MissingOwnerFieldsException`** (checked) + **`MissingOwnerFieldsExceptionHandler`** + its escalation YAML — the handler responds `400` with a `ProblemDetail` body carrying `errors: [...field names...]`.

3. **`ValidationExceptionHandler`** — extended to also emit an `errors` array of distinct field names. This covers the case where a *missing* field trips the generated DTO's `@NotNull` (e.g. absent `city`), which throws `MethodArgumentNotValidException` before `ValidateOwner`'s body runs — so both validation paths return the same `errors` shape.

4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `validate` step before `build`; **`BuildOwner`** now consumes the published `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` instead of re-reading `@RequestBody` (the body may be bound only once per pipeline).

`ValidateOwner` is shared with `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`, so the same reject-blank behavior now applies consistently to owner updates.
